{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_data['revenue'] = sales_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value (-1) count in customer_age:", (sales_data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded orders count:", (sales_data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check the distribution of channels and segments
print("Channel distribution:\n", sales_data['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", sales_data['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if channel and segment are confounded
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer segment:\n", pd.crosstab(sales_data['channel'], sales_data['customer_segment']))"}
